body:
selfhost/main.prn: build-files, a faithful port of src/main.c's cmd_build multi-file loop -- parses each input path, merges every file's top-level children into one combined unit, region-analyzes/emits/writes exactly once. Verified via direct C-level instrumentation (merge proven correct) plus a real end-to-end fixture + test (examples/selfhost_multifile_a.prn/_b.prn, tests/test_selfhost_main_multifile.c): both files together produce gcc-clean C with a genuinely resolved cross-file call; the callee alone honestly fails to compile. Corrected a stale NORTHSTAR.md claim (selfhost/lexer.prn 'still doesn't compile' was measuring it without its own stdlib/string.prn dependency -- it actually compiles clean) and confirmed the full 5-domain selfhost pipeline + stdlib deps already self-hosts examples/valid_only.prn end to end (an existing, undocumented, working Makefile target). Found and documented 3 real, separate selfhost/emit.prn gaps (defstruct not walked; bare alloc/arithmetic/match/cond body falls through to a broken fallback; plain-call let-values require bare-symbol args), not fixed this pass. Zero regressions: 336-test suite + all 5 selfhost domains + bazel build clean. PARENA commit cd7e0e7.

⚓ ☃
title: build-files: real multi-file support for the selfhost compiler + 3 real emit.prn gaps found
